newsitem.title: USA: Dec U.S. aluminum orders rise from Nov - Spector.
newsitem.headline: Dec U.S. aluminum orders rise from Nov - Spector.

text.p: Orders for aluminum mill products in the United States rose to 55.3 million pounds per day in December on a seasonally adjusted basis compared to 53.7 million in November, industry analyst Stewart Spector said.

December's non-cansheet bookings were just marginally better than the comparable year-ago level, but up from November. Cansheet bookings in December also improved from the month before, but were down 5.5 percent from December 1995.
Bookings in the final month of the year may have been dampened by holidays, Spector said.
Total bookings in December 1996 were still below the stronger performance in August, September and October when daily bookings averaged 61.6 million, 64.8 million and 61.8 million, respectively.
